subject: Next steps & scheduling: demo deep-dive + compliance items

From: Samira Khan <samira@orbithealthbook.com>

Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up from today's discovery — next meeting and attendees

Markus / team,

Thanks again for the call this morning — that was helpful. We walked through our current inference pain (bursty nightly jobs + inconsistent tail latency) and the security checklist items we're tracking for 2027 pilots.

Next steps on our side: we'd like to schedule a technical deep-dive/demo where your solutions engineer can show the serving runtime, batching behaviors, and how rollout policies work. Key participants from Orbit will be: Diego (CTO) and Jen (Head of Ops).

Suggested timeframe: any 60–75 minute slot next week (Nov 9–12) in the morning PT. If you can propose 2 options we can lock one. Also please include any pre-read or minimal agenda so we can circulate internally.

I've attached a short call notes PDF and pasted the high-level compliance items we flagged (data residency, audit logs, SOC2 evidence).

Thanks — Samira

Attachment: discovery-notes.pdf (summary of today's call, 3 pages)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's discovery — next meeting and attendees

Samira — thanks for the recap and for flagging the compliance items.

Availability: we can do both of these and I will hold slots until you confirm — please pick one that works best for your team:
- Tue Nov 9, 10:00–11:15 PT (90 min) — demo + Q&A; Aditya will focus on runtime and quantization; Grace will cover roadmap/CS support model
- Thu Nov 11, 08:30–09:45 PT (75 min) — tighter agenda, faster Q&A

Proposed agenda (can be trimmed):
1) 10 min — brief recap + success criteria
2) 30 min — runtime demo (batching, KV cache, fallback routing) — Aditya
3) 15 min — deployment options & security controls (VPC, KMS) — Markus
4) 20–30 min — Q&A, next steps / mutual action plan

I'll prepare a short mutual action plan and send the calendar invite once you confirm the time. We can also surface SOC2 artifacts and data residency notes in the drive link.

Cc'ing Aditya and Grace to keep them in the loop.

Cheers,
Markus Klein
